test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 14 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Poshan Abhiyaan is a program to achieve nutritional status of children from 0 to 6 years.

Which of the following Articles of the Indian Constitution provides for raising the nutrition level?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 47.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 47** states that "the State shall regard the raising of the **level of nutrition** and the **standard of living **of its people and the improvement of **public health **as among its primary duties".
 
• This article emphasizes the importance of improving the** overall health and well-being** of the citizens of India, including their nutritional status.
 
• **Poshan Abhiyaan** is a flagship scheme of the Government of India launched in** 2018 **to improve the** nutritional status** of children and pregnant women.
 
• The scheme aims to reduce** stunting, undernutrition, and low birth weight** by 2% annually and focuses on the first **1,000 day**s of a child's life.
 
• The scheme covers various interventions such as the promotion of **breastfeeding, complementary feeding, micro-nutrient supplementation, and hygiene and sanitation.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 44** pertains to the **Uniform Civil Code **and aims to promote the welfare of the people by securing a uniform civil code throughout the country.
 
• **Article 46 **provides for the promotion of educational and economic interests of the** weaker sections of society,** including Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes.
 
• **Article 45** provides for free and compulsory education for all children until they complete the age of **14 years.**
